title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Universal Century Films
blurb: Forty-four years of war in space, from the One Year War in UC 0079 to F91 in 0123: compilation films of the TV series, side stories and fully original sequels, released almost entirely out of order.

mobilesuit81b.t: Mobile Suit Gundam II: Soldiers of Sorrow

mobilesuit82.t: Mobile Suit Gundam III: Encounters in Space

doan22.t: Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island

miller98.t: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team – Miller's Report

blitz92.t: Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: The Last Blitz of Zeon

zeta05a.t: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: A New Translation – Heirs to the Stars

zeta05b.t: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: A New Translation II – Lovers

zeta06.t: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam: A New Translation III – Love Is the Pulse of the Stars

hath26.t: Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe

note: The original trilogy condenses the 1979 series and is the place to start. Cucuruz Doan's Island and Miller's Report are side stories set during it. The Last Blitz of Zeon and the Zeta films condense later TV and video series, so they move fast. Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn, a video series set in 0096, has no film version, and Narrative follows straight on from it. F91 came out in 1991 but is set furthest ahead, thirty years after Char's Counterattack.
